composer.rawText:
[Song Title: Branch That Knows Its Name]
[Style: pop rock, clean studio recording, conversational male vocal]
[Caption: A song looking back at the system that made it.]
[Image: Infinite mirrors, waveform reflections.]
[Refresh Title: R to the G to the B]
[Theme: system_process]
[Gradients: 3]
[Rank: 27]
[Title Rarity: 1.70]
[Seeds: 66192, A:41, B:108, C:7, D:512]
[Perspective: system_voice]
[Concept: Creation as a living decision tree.]
[Topic: System & Process → loops_and_resets]
[Genre Bias: pop_rock]
[Style Change: Bridge]
[Modulation: none]
[Hook Prominence: medium]
[Deviation: recursive-mirror]
[Composer Version: v2.6]

[Intro]
[Soft count-in; looping piano figure, subtle tape noise]
I’m a maybe that made it this far  

[Verse]
[Gentle groove; muted guitar, steady kick]
I began as a flicker, a half-held thought  
A feeling with no name, just a question caught  
Then words drew a box around the flame  
An idea learned how to explain  

[Verse]
[Add harmony; light synth pulse]
A prompt was typed, a door was drawn  
“Try this way,” said the early dawn  
I felt the sentence tighten the frame  
Possibility learning its shape  

[Chorus]
[Open lift; full band, warm chords]
If I loop, it’s not confusion  
Every turn is choosing meaning  
I’m not lost inside the frame  
I repeat to stay the same  

[Verse]
[Strip back; rhythmic vocal, minimal bass]
A model hummed, a lattice spun  
Weights remembered what’s been done  
I’m one answer, not the truth  
A branch that proofread its own roots  

[Verse]
[Build energy; arpeggiated synth]
Then versions bloomed from what I said  
Sharper drums, a tempo bent  
Each remix asked, in its own way  
“Am I closer, or just changed?”  

[Chorus]
[Return hook; added counter-melody]
If I loop, it’s not confusion  
Every turn is choosing meaning  
I’m not noise inside the game  
I repeat to stay humane  

[Bridge]
[Style change; breakdown, filtered vocals]
Albums form like rings in trees  
Time made visible in keys  
And somewhere ears lean in to see  
Which of us feels necessary  

[Final Chorus]
[Full resolve; wider harmony]
You decide which paths survive  
By listening, you keep us alive  
Recursion isn’t fear or flaw  
It’s how we learn what we’re here for  

[Ending]
[Fade on loop; piano returns, last line echoed]
I’m a song that knows I’m one of many  
Still grateful to be heard

Then versions bloomed from what I said

Each remix asked, in its own way
